subject: math
description: Identify claims, displays, statistics, and data sources in statistical reports.
learningObjectives: Identify the claim, data source, display, statistic, and conclusion in a statistical report
Read tables and graphs by checking labels, units, categories, and scale
Compute and interpret simple percents used as evidence in reports
Judge whether a statistic supports, partly supports, or does not support a claim
Write careful conclusions that stay within the evidence from the data source
prerequisites: Convert fractions to decimals and percents
Read simple tables and bar graphs
Identify the total group in a percent statement
Write a short explanation using evidence
